en: Title: Sarvakarmāvaraṇaviśodhanī Source: Cambridge University Library Ms. Add. 1680.8.3 Tibetan: D 743 [=1009]

Homage to the Blessed One, Akṣobhya, the Tathāgata, Arhat, Samyaksaṃbuddha! It is thus: Oṃ hūṃ kakani kakani, vākani vākani, rocani rocani, troṭani troṭani, saṃtrāsani saṃtrāsani, [repeat] twice, pratihana pratihana, all successions of karmic actions, svāhā! Whoever should see this dhāraṇī, even if it is merely written upon a wall, for them the five acts of immediate retribution shall be completely exhausted.
